location.basis: Wikidata coordinates for Nausharo (Q2039702: 29.365 N, 67.588 E, given to three decimals) fall beside a tree-covered mound surrounded by fields on the Kachhi plain; the coordinates are the published ones.

sources.citation_or_service: Esri World Imagery tile service, https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}; Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.north_label_text: Web Mercator grid north (true north at every point; north up)

main_system_reason: No Harappan line could be identified in the imagery.
notes: Optional town. The mound is covered by trees and scrub and shows no wall; the straight lines around it are field bunds of the surrounding farmland (themselves laid out on a slightly rotated grid), which we excluded. Not measured.
